clos.original_description: Understand the basics of computer vision, its related fields, and its applications
clos.enriched_description: Understand the basics of computer vision, its related fields, and its applications. The scope includes Welcome to Computer Vision and Computer vision overviews.

clos.original_description: Understand the concepts of image formation: image representation, lighting, image acquisition through the camera, camera calibration techniques.
clos.enriched_description: Understand the concepts of image formation: image representation, lighting, image acquisition through the camera, camera calibration techniques. The scope includes Image formation, Photometric image formation, and The digital camera.

clos.enriched_description: Basic knowledge of image processing on points, lines, image filtering techniques and corresponding algorithm implementation. The scope includes Image processing and Points and patches.

clos.enriched_description: Understand the techniques of feature extraction and matching, implement the techniques of edges, lines extraction. The scope includes Feature detection and matching, Edges, and Lines.

clos.enriched_description: Understand the basics of segmentation, techniques such as active contours, split and merge, mean shift and mode finding. The scope includes Segmentation and Split and merge.

clos.enriched_description: Discuss feature-based alignments like 2D and 3D feature-based alignment. The scope includes Feature-based alignment and D and 3D feature-based alignment.

clos.original_description: Discuss the principles and the implementation of Image stitching
clos.enriched_description: Discuss the principles and the implementation of Image stitching. The scope includes Image stitching and Lab 4 assistant and interview.

clos.original_description: Understand and implement the object detection techniques
clos.enriched_description: Understand and implement the object detection techniques. The scope includes Detection and Object detection.

clos.original_description: Explain the principles of face recognition, object tracking
